digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot service initialization and authorization
propositions: Long-running MCP and review-bot processes currently re-read static configuration and auth material per-operation, allowing inconsistent state changes during in-flight requests and preventing clean restart/redeploy rotation.

MCP inbound bearer tokens and OAuth material must remain request-scoped and absent from startup bindings, operation snapshots, and logs; OperationSnapshot.build must reject secret-typed configuration.

Review-bot must validate decision-bearing Gerrit/GitHub auth synchronously before accepting work, fail closed on missing or revoked credentials with no principal fallback, and forward the startup-composed LLMRuntime into each code review operation.

Static deployment bindings composed at service startup must remain frozen and isolated from subsequent ambient environment/file mutations; observed changes must require process restart, while native SDK-owned refresh behavior is preserved.
Partial or rejected Langfuse/OTLP telemetry configuration must disable observability without altering operation results; security-critical auth must remain fail-closed regardless of telemetry state.

The implemented solution must pass held-out TDD oracles covering startup binding purity, decision-auth fail-closed guards, token non-leak guarantees, and end-to-end AWS review-bot canary validation with no credential leakage.
